newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: U.N.'s Annan to see S.Africa's Mandela on Timor.
newsitem.headline: U.N.'s Annan to see S.Africa's Mandela on Timor.

text.p: U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan will visit South African President Nelson Mandela on Friday to discuss their joint initiative for peace in Indonesian-ruled East Timor, officials said on Monday.
An official in Mandela's office said the government had originally expected an envoy, but had been told on Monday to expect Annan.
Foreign Ministry spokesman Pieter Swanepoel confirmed that arrangements were being made to receive Annan, adding:
"Mr Annan and the President will continue their discussions about East Timor."
Mandela visited Indonesia last month and persuaded President Suharto to allow him to meet jailed rebel leader Xanana Gusmao.
He has since asked Suharto in a letter to release Gusmao as a first step towards easing the conflict in East Timor and has invited Suharto to South Africa in November.
Government sources said Annan's unexpected visit pointed to an acceleration of the United Nation's intiative with Mandela to resolve the East Timor conflict.
